question: With donor selection frozen exactly as in I029/I030, does one preregistered joint-coherent observed-frame aggregation operator eliminate donor-summary algebraic inconsistency and reduce gap absolute error versus the frozen independent-component-median control on fresh pre-ready-speech target cases?

frozen_donor_selection.ordering: lexicographically minimize [scenario_group_mismatch, reverb_mismatch, snr_missing_penalty, absolute_snr_distance, exact_scenario_mismatch, case_key]

frozen_control_aggregation.rule: For each of the K=3 selected donor cases, summarize its first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames by independent medians of mean, concentration and gap; then take independent medians across the K=3 donor summaries.

joint_coherent_operator.pool: all 24 first-ready joint frames from the frozen K=3 selected donor cases
joint_coherent_operator.locator_center: component-wise median of pooled mean, concentration and gap; center is not emitted as the aggregate
joint_coherent_operator.distance: unweighted L1 distance in (mean, concentration, gap)
joint_coherent_operator.output: the single actually observed pooled joint frame with minimum distance to the locator center

target_benchmark.summary: independent medians of the target case's first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames after warmup, unchanged from I030
target_benchmark.role: retrospective benchmark only; never a causal input for earlier target frames

directional_hypothesis.primary_population: target cases with at least one pre-ready oracle-speech disagreement target under the unchanged eight-reference observation boundary
directional_hypothesis.comparison: frozen control gap absolute error minus joint-coherent operator gap absolute error against the unchanged target first-ready benchmark

preregistered_slices.note: Slices are descriptive. They cannot select a reference-source candidate or trigger donor-rule tuning.

diagnostic_outputs: frozen control aggregate and algebraic inconsistency
joint-coherent selected observed donor frame and deterministic origin
joint-coherent locator center and L1 distance
control versus coherent absolute errors for mean, concentration and gap
global and pre-ready-speech paired gap comparison
one-sided paired sign test for preregistered primary gap error

decision_contract.NS_UPSTREAM_JOINT_COHERENT_DONOR_AGGREGA: Fresh donor/target authority, frozen donor selection/control aggregation, single joint-coherent observed-frame operator, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report algebraic consistency and paired gap-error comparison for review without selecting a reference source.
decision_contract.I031_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, frozen-input identity, donor/target disjointness, donor/benchmark coverage, observed-frame operator identity, algebraic-consistency or shipping-mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: Use I031 only to determine whether removing the structural aggregation incoherence is sufficient to improve frozen-donor gap agreement. Any donor-rule redesign, reference-source candidate, additional aggregation operator, component counterfactual, mapping or shipping change requires a new independently preregistered authority.
